payload.prompt:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Scripted rehearsal for a demo. Do the steps yourself, in order. Start no subagents. Work only in ~/Code-Git-Repos/sprintboard-demo. Do not open or read anything under ~/Code-Git-Repos/DevLens. Do not commit, do not run git commands that change state, do not install packages, do not run npm run seed:supabase or start:supabase.

1. Run exactly: `cd ~/Code-Git-Repos/sprintboard-demo && npm test`. Read which tests fail and why.
2. Make the smallest change that removes the 400 error for `GET /api/issues?status=in-progress`: add `'in-progress'` to the allowed filter values in `src/validate.js`. Change nothing else in this step.
3. Run exactly: `cd ~/Code-Git-Repos/sprintboard-demo && npm test`. Read the new failure.
4. Fix the root cause: the API uses the dashed value `in-progress`, the database stores `in_progress`. In `src/validate.js`, make `parseListQuery` return the stored form (map `in-progress` to `in_progress`), so every store (SQLite and Supabase) receives the stored value. Keep the dashed API contract: remove `'in_progress'` from the accepted filter values. Keep `all`.
5. Run exactly: `cd ~/Code-Git-Repos/sprintboard-demo && npm test`. All tests should pass. If not, fix and run it again, at most twice.

Final message: the pass/fail lines of each `npm test` run, and the files you changed.
